lead: A goal record's check can fail on a file no session wrote — the user edits this tree too.
body: An uncommitted hand edit to a spec or an inventory the check reads can be right and still fail it, and staging it to make the check pass takes the user's in-flight work into your commit. `git status --short` before diagnosing says whose change it is; a fix that lands in the *tool* that reads them is committable on its own without touching those files.
